items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Split On AI And ARR
items.summary: Analysts have reset the internal fair value estimate for Adobe from US$275.06 to US$268.30, a modest change that still matters for how you think about the stock. This move reflects mixed research views, with some firms lifting price targets into the US$220 to US$315 range, while others trim targets toward US$225 to US$275 as they weigh freemium and AI potential against softer ARR trends and competition. As you read on, you will see how to track these shifting narratives and what they may mean...
